verdict.rationale: Gram provides tool-call logs, usage dashboards with spend, agent sessions, tool calls, and risk findings counts (gram-docs-25), plus cost/token tracking, budgets, and effectiveness measurement across teams (gram-gh-1), and per-employee exportable call records (gram-docs-29). This covers call volumes, users, errors (risk findings/logs), and cost as requested, though the evidence is vendor-sourced dashboard screenshots rather than independent validation of accuracy/scale. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of dashboard accuracy, more detail on error-rate breakdowns specifically (vs risk findings), and per-tool/per-server cost attribution granularity.
